hero.headline: Human-Governed Quality Review for Selected Enterprise Consulting Deliverables
hero.subheadline: Proposed 6-week pilot concept pairing automated first-pass checklist screening (8 documents, 1 agreed document type, 1 customer-approved checklist) with qualified human review and mandatory human sign-off.

props.sectionSubtitle: Redesigned review workflow around a 6-week pilot, 8 documents, 5 outputs, and human accountability (intended / to be measured)
props.prop1Desc: Covers 8 documents of 1 agreed document type against 1 customer-approved checklist across a 6-week pilot engagement.
props.prop2Desc: Classifies items as pass, fail, or exception, routing missing evidence or failed checks to HOLD / RETURN for remediation and re-entry.
props.prop3Desc: Automated screening handles routine first-pass checks only; qualified human reviewers retain professional judgment, final approval, and client release authority.
props.prop4Desc: Defines an Agreed Checklist, First-Pass Screening Summary, Exception Register, Human Decision Log, and Pilot Evaluation.

workflow.sectionSubtitle: 01 INTAKE -> 02 CHECK -> 03 SCREEN -> 04 ROUTE (with HOLD / RETURN) -> 05 REVIEW -> 06 SIGN OFF
workflow.pageTitle: Six-Step Human-Governed Review Workflow & Five Pilot Outputs
workflow.pageSubtitle: 6-week pilot engagement covering 8 documents of 1 agreed document type and 1 customer-approved checklist
workflow.diagramTitle: Three-Stage Pilot Flow & HOLD / RETURN Path
workflow.step1Desc: Receive the approved document and agreed scope for the 6-week pilot engagement.
workflow.step1Inputs: Approved sample/authorized document (1 of 8 per engagement), agreed scope, document type.
workflow.step1Outputs: Logged intake record, scope alignment check, or HOLD / RETURN if scope/document is incomplete.
workflow.step2Desc: Check access, data requirements, and the customer-approved checklist.
workflow.step2Inputs: Authorized access, required source data, customer-approved checklist.
workflow.step2Outputs: Readiness verification or HOLD / RETURN when required access, data, or checklist items are missing.
workflow.step3Desc: Run an automated first-pass check against the agreed checklist and basic document requirements.
workflow.step3Inputs: Verified document package, agreed checklist, basic document completeness rules.
workflow.step3Outputs: First-Pass Screening Summary and candidate check findings for routing.
workflow.step4Desc: Classify items as pass, fail, or exception; route failed checks or missing evidence to HOLD / RETURN.
workflow.step4Inputs: First-pass screening results, checklist criteria, exception thresholds.
workflow.step4Outputs: Exception Register entries, items routed to HOLD / RETURN for remediation and re-entry, or items queued for REVIEW.
workflow.step5Desc: A qualified human reviewer evaluates flagged or uncertain items and re-evaluates remediated HOLD / RETURN items.
workflow.step5Inputs: Flagged/uncertain items, Exception Register, source-document references, remediated HOLD / RETURN items.
workflow.step5Outputs: Human reviewer evaluation, rationale, and remediation disposition.
workflow.step6Desc: Record the human decision and final approval; never release autonomously.
workflow.step6Inputs: Completed human review findings, remediation status, accountable reviewer authority.
workflow.step6Outputs: Human Decision Log entry and human sign-off for client-facing release.

diagram.gate1Desc: Agree scope, checklist, acceptance criteria, and baseline; verify access, data requirements, and approved inputs, routing incomplete items to HOLD / RETURN.
diagram.gate2Desc: Perform first-pass checks against the agreed checklist, classify items as pass, fail, or exception, route exceptions to human review, and route failed/missing items via HOLD / RETURN.
diagram.gate3Desc: Qualified human reviewers evaluate flagged or uncertain items, record human sign-off, and evaluate quality, effort, turnaround, rework, and cost; AI never approves autonomously.

deliverables.sectionSubtitle: Five outputs for the 6-week pilot engagement (8 documents, 1 agreed document type, 1 customer-approved checklist)
deliverables.deliv1Desc: Customer-approved criteria and acceptance requirements for one selected document type.
deliverables.deliv2Desc: Results of the agreed automated first-pass checks across the 8-document pilot scope.
deliverables.deliv3Desc: Flagged items, reasons, HOLD / RETURN items, and source-document references.
deliverables.deliv4Desc: Reviewer actions, rationale, and final human sign-off records.
deliverables.deliv5Desc: Review effort, turnaround, rework, quality, false positives, missed issues, and cost assessment.

pricing.pageSubtitle: Modeled service fee ($15,000) separated from historical platform cost proxy ($567/mo on 9-Nov-2026, S5) with 3-year Base and Downside figures.
pricing.phase1Desc: Unvalidated student estimate per 6-week engagement (8 docs, 35% target margin benchmark) vs. historical 9-Nov-2026 Essentials capture ($567/mo; $6,804/yr; $20,412 3-yr, S5).
pricing.phase1Item1: • $15,000 modeled fee is an unvalidated student estimate, not an official IBM price or confirmed willingness to pay
pricing.phase1Item2: • $567/mo Essentials price (9-Nov-2026 capture, S5) is a historical model proxy ($6,804/yr; $20,412 3-yr), not a current universal IBM quotation
pricing.phase1Item3: • Capacity: 1.0 FTE × 1,600 hrs/yr at 24 hrs/engagement (8 docs × 3 hrs) = 66 engagements/yr at $75/hr ($120,000/yr)
pricing.phase2Desc: Modeled service-level contribution & net cash flow (same-year collection/payment). Excludes unallocated corporate overhead, sales/acquisition costs, taxes, capex, and financing.
pricing.phase2Item3: • Downside 3-yr costs: $142,804 (Y1) + $133,804 (Y2) + $136,204 (Y3) = $412,812 (Y1 setup: $6,000 rules, $5,000 security; $400/eng data prep; $3,000/yr governance)
pricing.phase3Desc: Client baseline: 8 docs × 4 hrs × $125/hr = $4,000/engagement. Ratio: $15,000 / $4,000 = 375.0% (Modeled Service Fee / Estimated Client Baseline Review Cost).
pricing.phase3Item1: • 375.0% is a price-to-baseline-cost ratio — NOT time savings, ROI, or demonstrated customer value
pricing.phase3Item3: • Academic target price at 35% contribution margin: $13,316.52 / (1 - 35%) = $20,486.95 (unvalidated model output)

trust.pageSubtitle: Proposed governance design and controls to be validated before any live pilot; no existing IBM guarantees or unverified security claims are asserted.
trust.card1Desc: Proposed workflow routes exceptions and HOLD / RETURN items to qualified human reviewers, records reviewer actions and rationale in a proposed Human Decision Log, and keeps final approval and release accountable to people.
trust.card2Desc: Requires validation prior to pilot: authorized access and approved sample documents, agreed data minimization and retention/deletion rules, data location, tenant isolation, model data usage, access management, audit-log immutability (if needed), and security approval.

governance.boundaryText: Automated first-pass checks screen against a customer-approved checklist and route items or HOLD / RETURN exceptions, while qualified human reviewers make final decisions and sign-off. Never autonomous.
